statements.speaker: OFFICER
statements.text: For this fictional interview, please describe why you entered the bank.

statements.speaker: COLE
statements.text: I came in with Rowan and the others. I thought we were meeting someone.

statements.speaker: OFFICER
statements.text: Witnesses describe three men with weapons. Were you carrying one?

statements.speaker: COLE
statements.text: No. I did not have a gun. I saw someone raise something, but I could not tell you what.

statements.speaker: OFFICER
statements.text: Were customers moved into the back hallway?

statements.speaker: COLE
statements.text: People were shouting. I saw some go toward the hallway. I did not order them there.

statements.speaker: OFFICER
statements.text: Did you hear a demand for cash?

statements.speaker: COLE
statements.text: I heard shouting about money, then an alarm. I wanted out.

statements.speaker: OFFICER
statements.text: The lobby synopsis places a figure resembling you near the counter afterward.

statements.speaker: COLE
statements.text: That could be someone dressed like me. You cannot see the face in that clip.

statements.speaker: OFFICER
statements.text: Did you touch any money or a bag?

statements.speaker: COLE
statements.text: No. I did not take anything.

statements.speaker: OFFICER
statements.text: Why were you stopped on the plaza?

statements.speaker: COLE
statements.text: I ran when other people were running. That is all.
